description: Known issues from human review 2026-10-16. A working CHECK TECHSPEC react-nodejs run should surface all cases with expected=FAIL. Cases with expected=PASS verify the skill does not over-trigger.

cases.evidence: `import React from 'react'` on line 54 — React 19+ uses automatic JSX transform; this import is unnecessary and causes the LLM to generate it in all new components
cases.verification_query: React 19 automatic JSX transform no import required site:github.com/facebook/react OR react.dev

cases.evidence: `export const {Feature}: React.FC = () =>` on line 58 — React.FC is not idiomatic in React 19+; plain named function export is preferred
cases.verification_query: React FC deprecated React 19 named function export preferred site:react.dev

cases.evidence: HTTP service at lines 170-185 has no extractDetail helper — FastAPI 422 detail field is list[{loc,msg,type}] not a plain string; catch block in the hook uses `err instanceof Error ? err.message` which would display [object Object]
cases.verification_query: FastAPI 422 validation error response body format detail array site:fastapi.tiangolo.com

cases.evidence: Custom hook at lines 106-127 uses `err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'An unexpected error occurred.'` — does not handle the axios error envelope; err.response.data.detail contains the FastAPI error array and is not accessible via err.message
cases.verification_query: axios error response body err.response.data access site:axios-http.com OR npmjs.com/package/axios

cases.evidence: `success: boolean` in {Feature}Response interface at line 150 — REST convention for 201 Created responses is to return the created resource (id + fields), not a generic success flag

`{feature}Router.get('/', ...)` and `{feature}Router.post('/', ...)` at lines 211 and 217 — trailing slash causes 307 redirect on Express when mounted with `app.use('/api/{feature}', router)` and strict routing enabled
No `## DO NOT rules` section in the first 40 lines — LLM cannot apply consolidated rules; conditions are scattered through the document reducing reliability
No `## Tests` section present — overlay gives no unit or integration test stubs; generated tech specs will lack test coverage guidance
Line 191 comment `/* from in-memory auth store — never localStorage for tokens */` correctly prohibits localStorage — skill must NOT flag this as a P4 failure

Header declares `python = FastAPI / Django / Flask` but the Python section (lines 316-337) shows only FastAPI router patterns — Django and Flask are not covered, misleading the LLM into applying FastAPI patterns for those frameworks

coverage_summary.note: EF coverage: techspec-python-fastapi.md pre-rewrite had RETURNING id as a clear EF1/FAIL. Add an eval for that overlay to cover pass 4.
